name: James G. Ramsey
role: Glendive live-stock broker and insurance agent
bio: James G. Ramsey was a Glendive live-stock broker who in 1885 advertised Iowa yearling steers and grade Hereford bulls and made a number of sales. In 1886 he advertised accident insurance for cowboys, and by August he was agent for a Chicago stock commission firm.
